subtitles.cosmicbreach.echo.first_shard: "You can hear it... can't you? Take me home."
subtitles.cosmicbreach.echo.ring_open: "The ground remembers the sky. Now... fall up."
subtitles.cosmicbreach.echo.drift: "Do you hear that? One more voice. The Drift will carry you now."
subtitles.cosmicbreach.echo.deep: "Below us, the song goes silent. Bring your light."
subtitles.cosmicbreach.echo.sanctum: "They remember how to sing. He is waiting, at the bottom of the Breach."
subtitles.cosmicbreach.echo.sealed: "The Breach is sealed. Sing with us."
commands.cosmicbreach.echo.reset: The Echo will say every line again
